steps: Cook Rice according to package instructions, then spread on a tray and cool for 10 minutes.
Peel and pit the Avocado, then mash it in a small bowl with Lemon juice until smooth.
Peel the Cucumber and dice it finely into 5 mm cubes.
In a large bowl, combine cooled Rice, mashed Avocado, diced Cucumber, Chia seeds, and Tamari sauce.
Stir gently until the mixture holds together; add a few drops of water if too dry.
Using wet hands, shape the mixture into 20 small oval bites, about 30 g each.
Sprinkle ground Sesame seeds lightly over each bite.
Arrange on a lined plate and refrigerate for 10 minutes to firm up before serving.
Serve chilled; keep covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Makes 20 bites · 4 family portions.
